question: What does a stand-in cost an ESEA team?
answer: About 2 pp beyond the five's own ratings, too small to beat held-out matches. Rate the five who play.
findings: After player Elo + FACEIT level of the five: first stand-in -0.09 log-odds (SE 0.04), second +0.16.
Held S58-S59 log loss: t -1.5, leave-one-day-out t -0.3. Not shipped.
Stand-in's FACEIT level counts like a core player's: .59 vs .54 log-odds per level (SE .08/.04).
method: Core = 5 most-used players in the team's prior 20 maps that season (no lookahead). Logistic on the five's round-share player Elo and FACEIT level plus stand-in count, walk-forward ratings.
data: FACEIT ESEA NA league, S53-S59, 18,217 matches; 6,078 with both cores defined
split_check: First stand-in negative in 4 of 5 seasons; a whole-season core (lookahead) inflates the raw gap to 54.9% vs 50.1%.
